_readme: THE PAID-CALLS REGISTER — every call to a per-call PAID API, who pays for it, and what gates it.
🔴 CUSTOMER PAYS (owner lock 2026-10-01: "If using AI ... it should come from customer pocket").
No AI and no per-call paid API on any path WE pay for without the customer paying: either the
user's own key (`mode: byok`, the call goes from the device to the provider and our server never
sees the key or the content) or OUR key behind a paid plan or paid credits, metered, hard-capped
(`mode: metered`). `payer` is therefore always `customer`, and the guard refuses anything else.
· every row: a host, a kind, payer `customer`, a mode, callers that exist;
· every `gate` anchor is a fragment its file still contains — the reservation and the plan check
for a metered row, the device key read for a byok row; deleting one exits 1; a gate's
`requires`/`forbid` fragments are checked in the body of the function its anchor opens, so a
plan check that answers 'paid' unconditionally exits 1 though its first line still stands;
· every `ai-inference` row names its feature's disclosure string keys (each must exist in the
named ARB) and its output marker fields (each must appear in the named file) — EU AI Act
Art. 50(1) and 50(2), for every future AI feature;
· COVERAGE: every non-test source file under `scanRoots` that names a host's needle is a
`caller` of a row for that host — a new paid call with no row exits 1;
· COVERAGE LOST (exit 2): no rows, or the scan found no caller at all.

rows.why: OUR key (NIKATRU_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, server-only) for AI import and AI review. A call is made only after the meter reserved a PAID credit: a paid plan's monthly allowance (none in a trial) or a verified pack credit, under the per-user daily cap and the global daily spend circuit-breaker, with the kill switch off.

gate.why: the adapter asks the meter before the wire
the reservation: one paid credit, the caps, atomically
the plan check: only a PAID grant is paid (no trial, comp, promo code or PROMOTIONAL)
requires: else if (e.provider !== null && (e.store ?? '').toLowerCase() !== PROMOTIONAL_STORE) paid = true;
